fact_groups.fact: Algorithm has virtual destructor/clear/write(single storage)/read(node)/empty; base clear is empty, write/read use CV_UNUSED which expands to void cast, base empty returns false. Base defaults do not prove behavior of all derived overrides.

Two-argument storage/name write overload is not declared virtual; selected body calls one-argument virtual write, with empty-name early return versus wrapping a named mapping. A nonvirtual wrapper can contain a virtual dispatch site.

Static read template calls _Tp::create(), obj->read(fn), then returns object if !obj->empty(), otherwise default Ptr. No selected node-empty or explicit null-create guard. Expression compatibility and Ptr requirements matter; actual instantiation not compiled.

load uses FileStorage READ, CV_Assert(isOpened), first top-level node or named lookup, explicit node-empty early empty Ptr, create/read/empty predicate. No universal successful deserialization guarantee.

loadFromString uses READ+MEMORY and selects node then create/read/empty predicate; unlike selected load body, no explicit isOpened assertion or node-empty early return. That syntactic difference does not prove all invalid input behavior without FileStorage/FileNode/derived source/runtime.

save/getDefaultName virtual declarations; selected save opens WRITE storage, writes getDefaultName node, calls one-arg write and closes mapping. Base getDefaultName returns my_object; protected writeFormat emits format integer3. No complete/successful file transaction guarantee.

CV_STATIC_ANALYSIS alternative CV_Assert aborts on false; ordinary branch calls cv::error(StsAssert,...). Do not confuse CV_Assert with debug-only CV_DbgAssert or promise one universal exception/termination mode across builds.
Deprecated pointer-storage overload declaration is conditional on CV_VERSION_MAJOR <5. Selected algorithm.cpp absence does not prove global removal/unavailability or active build version.
Root Apache2 text and selected file BSD-style three-condition notices coexist; preserve actual notices and attribution. Root license alone does not certify all files/uses.
